_comment: All third-party dependencies must be registered here before use in production. 'pending' commercial_use_review is a production gate failure.

dependencies.name: VideoManip
dependencies.reason: Repository revision, weights, transitive licenses, and commercial use require review.

dependencies.name: SAM 2.1 Large
dependencies.reason: Official code and checkpoint bytes are pinned; target-domain benchmark and complete commercial review remain required.

dependencies.name: HaMeR
dependencies.reason: Code, checkpoint, MANO asset, and transitive model terms require approval; MANO is injected privately and never redistributed.

dependencies.name: ViTPose
dependencies.reason: Pinned HaMeR transitive pose model; code, checkpoint, and target-domain use require review.

dependencies.name: Detectron2 ViTDet
dependencies.reason: Pinned HaMeR transitive detector and model bytes; target-domain and transitive review remain required.

dependencies.name: MoGe 2
dependencies.reason: Official code and exact model bytes are pinned; monocular metric accuracy and DINOv2/model-card commercial terms still require target-domain review.

dependencies.name: utils3d
dependencies.reason: Transitive dependency installed by the pinned MoGe revision; license and deployment review remain open.

dependencies.name: pipeline
dependencies.reason: Transitive dependency installed by the pinned MoGe revision; license and deployment review remain open.

dependencies.name: MANO
dependencies.reason: Model files are locally held and must never be committed or redistributed.

dependencies.name: Do As I Do
dependencies.reason: Top-level code is MIT; every submodule, model weight, and dataset term still needs transitive review.

dependencies.name: MuJoCo Warp
dependencies.reason: Pinned by Do As I Do together with warp-lang 1.10.1 and MuJoCo 3.4.0; deployment and transitive terms require review.

dependencies.name: GMR
dependencies.reason: MIT repository; robot meshes, motion datasets, and target-specific configuration require separate review.

dependencies.name: TWIST general motion tracker
dependencies.reason: MIT repository and pinned public checkpoint passed FORGE sim2sim evaluation; checkpoint, robot assets, SDK, and physical-hardware deployment still require separate approval.

dependencies.name: SMPL-X Python library
dependencies.reason: Transitive GMR dependency observed on the A40 evaluation pod; model assets and their license remain external.

dependencies.name: ASAP
dependencies.reason: Research stack has simulator, dataset, robot SDK, and model-weight dependencies requiring review.

dependencies.name: InterMimic
dependencies.reason: Used as a whole-body interaction benchmark/adapter candidate; transitive terms and robot integration remain gated.

dependencies.name: FORGE stable-contact compiler
dependencies.reason: FORGE-owned paper-derived implementation; still requires profile validation.

dependencies.name: FORGE direct robot-state compiler
dependencies.reason: FORGE-owned contract path; each source robot still requires a calibration certificate.

dependencies.name: Aerial six-DoF source adapter
dependencies.reason: Provider and per-platform flight validation are not pinned.

dependencies.name: Whole-body metric reconstruction adapter
dependencies.reason: A commercially usable, benchmarked implementation has not yet been pinned.
